title: Tyree, 17:
title_q: “I Didn't Even Open the Second Box”
headline: A 17-year-old opens the first box, sees Travis Scotts, and never opens the second one.
story: A volunteer brings out two boxes. Tyree opens the first one: Travis Scotts. He is so happy he never opens the second box. He is growing his shoe game, and he can't wait to wear them to school.
Then he thanks everybody, and his mom. This is pure sneaker joy in a teenager's own words. It is the younger, sneaker-culture video Soles4Souls asked for. Fun and happy. No need, no hardship.
do: Open on the shoe held up to the lens, with <q>He never opened box two.</q> on frame 1.
Show the shoe again at the end (04:06–04:12) before the end card.
dont: No name super in V1. The spelling is not confirmed.
Don't use 02:07–02:12 (he counts how many shoes he owns).
No sad music. No need or hardship angle.
Don't use 02:17–02:23 (“they feel amazing”). That line belongs to the teen montage.
No logo, fade or title card at 0:00.
